description: Two youths who were actively protesting the CJP's core committee list found themselves hospitalized on Monday. Manish Brahmabhatt and Rahul Pandya reported that police intervened forcibly. They criticized the CJP leadership for favoritism, alleging that they were excluded in favor of new members. Despite their hospitalization, the protest remains strong as new volunteers take their place, committed to continuing the hunger strike.
title: ​​Youths on indefinite hunger strike against CJP founder shifted to hospital
